verdict.rationale: Gitleaks.io describes team-wide scanning of pull requests and commits, so a data-portability question is fair to ask here. However, the evidence never documents a way to export all of a user's data in open formats and leave. The only related item is the findings.json report produced by baseline scans, which is scan output and not a data-export or offboarding capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
